loc_1.name: Ember Hollow Village Square
loc_1.description:
The central square is paved with smooth river stones and ringed by wooden benches, flower planters, and a large communal hearth that burns day and night. A carved stone fountain stands near the center, its water kept warm by a gentle enchantment. Market stalls fold up each evening, leaving space for dances, lessons, and casual conversation.

Several paths radiate outward from the square, each marked by a small signpost with hand-painted directions. The air carries the scent of roasting chestnuts in winter and fresh bread year-round. A notice board near the fountain displays recipes, workshop schedules, and requests for help.
loc_1.shortDescription: Central gathering space with a hearth, fountain, and market stalls.

Several paths radiate from the square, each marked by a small hand-painted signpost pointing toward the community kitchen, herbal alchemy shop, general store, and other parts of Ember Hollow. A notice board beside the fountain is filled with recipes, workshop schedules, and requests for help, fluttering slightly in the breeze. The air carries the comforting scent of fresh bread and, in colder seasons, roasting chestnuts. The scene is peaceful and inviting, with no signs of danger, only the quiet hum of daily life.

loc_2.name: Community Kitchen Exterior
loc_2.description:
A wide wooden building with a red-tiled roof and a large chimney that smells perpetually of garlic and thyme. The front porch holds stacked crates of vegetables, hanging braids of dried peppers, and a sign that lists today's shared meals. A small herb garden borders the side wall, neatly divided into labeled plots.

The entrance features double doors with frosted glass panels, letting golden light spill onto the path. Inside, the sounds of chopping, stirring, and laughter can be heard on most days. A chalkboard outside notes who is cooking and when the next communal dinner will be served.

loc_23.name: Main Cooking Hall
loc_23.description:
The central space opens around a long wooden table scarred by years of chopping and ladling. At the far wall, three heavy stoves feed a row of large iron cauldrons, and a copper kettle whistles when the heat rises too high. Recipe cards and faded photos are pinned to the boards between the shelves, held up by thumbtacks and bits of twine.

A chalkboard near the entrance lists today’s meals and who is on duty. The air smells of garlic, onion, and wood smoke, and the floor is swept clean except for a few damp marks from mopped spills. A small bench along the wall holds stacks of chipped bowls and ladles ready for service.

loc_35.name: QA Clockwork Tram
loc_35.description:
The tram car is a cramped, heated box of brass fittings and reinforced glass. Steam hisses from pipes along the floor, keeping the interior warm despite the biting cold outside. The seats are worn leather, bolted to the floor, and the windows are frosted with ice patterns that the conductor occasionally wipes clear. The engine rumbles steadily beneath the floorboards, vibrating through the soles of anyone standing.

A small ticket puncher sits on a shelf near the driver's booth. The air smells of coal smoke and sweet tea. The tram moves silently along the tracks, gliding over the frost-hardened earth between the settlement and the eastern platform.

loc_36.name: QA East Platform
loc_36.description:
A wide, open-air loading dock where the tram tracks end. The platform is paved with heavy iron plates that rattle underfoot. A large, covered waiting shelter stands at the far end, its roof coated in a layer of fresh snow. The air here smells of coal dust and wet wool.

    Beyond the platform edge, the land drops away into a misty valley. A rope bridge connects to the opposite side, swaying slightly in the wind. Cargo crates from the Iron Petal Syndicate are stacked neatly near the shelter, marked with red wax seals.
loc_36.shortDescription: Open-air loading dock with iron plates and a rope bridge.

loc_39.name: March Start Marker
loc_39.description: A rusted iron post driven into the frozen earth, marking the edge of Ember Hollow's territory. The metal is pitted with age, and a small plaque lists the distance to the next waypoint in faded paint. The ground here is trampled hard by countless travelers, creating a smooth, icy patch that offers little traction. The wind howls through the post's hollow core, creating a low, mournful tone that serves as the unofficial boundary bell for the settlement. Beyond this point, the path widens into the open Frost March, where the snow is deeper and the trees give way to exposed, rolling tundra.
loc_39.shortDescription: Rusted iron post marking the start of the frozen frontier.

loc_43.name: QA Fast Travel Grove
loc_43.description:
A small, sheltered cluster of ancient pines stands at the edge of the tundra. Their branches are heavy with snow, forming a natural windbreak that dampens the roar of the open March. At the center lies a circle of flat stones, worn smooth by centuries of travelers’ boots. The ground here is slightly warmer, likely due to a faint residual magical current that keeps the permafrost from encroaching too aggressively.

    A low stone cairn marks the exact center, topped with a simple iron ring for tethering pack animals or cargo. The trees create a sense of separation from the harsh openness of the Frost March, offering a brief moment of quiet before the long walk back to civilization. The air smells of pine resin and damp earth, a stark contrast to the metallic tang of the nearby marker.
loc_43.shortDescription: Sheltered pine grove with a magical cairn for rest and fast travel.

loc_44.name: QA Fast Travel Tower
loc_44.description:
The tower rises from the tundra like a rusted needle, a skeletal iron frame bolted to a stone base. It stands isolated from the main path, visible only as a dark vertical line against the white horizon. The structure is stripped of warmth, designed only for function. Wind whistles through the open framework, carrying the sharp scent of ozone and old snow. The base is scarred by years of travelers seeking shelter from the blizzard that builds on the ridge.

    At the foot of the tower, a small cairn of stones marks the fast travel node. The stones are smooth and worn, piled high by countless hands. A faint hum vibrates from the ground, the magical residue of teleportation anchors. The air here is colder than the square, biting through wool and leather. The silence is absolute, broken only by the wind and the distant crack of ice.
loc_44.shortDescription: Isolated iron tower on the frozen tundra marking a magical fast travel node.

region_1.name: Ember Hollow Settlement
region_1.description: Ember Hollow is a cozy rural settlement where monster girls gather to share meals, craft skills, and tend their gardens. Stone pathways wind between timber houses, community workshops, and a central hearth that never goes cold. The air smells of baking bread, pine smoke, and fresh herbs.
region_1.shortDescription: Cozy rural settlement centered on shared meals, crafts, and warm community life.

locationBlueprints.name: Ember Hollow Village Square
locationBlueprints.description:
The central square is paved with smooth river stones and ringed by wooden benches, flower planters, and a large communal hearth that burns day and night. A carved stone fountain stands near the center, its water kept warm by a gentle enchantment. Market stalls fold up each evening, leaving space for dances, lessons, and casual conversation.

Several paths radiate outward from the square, each marked by a small signpost with hand-painted directions. The air carries the scent of roasting chestnuts in winter and fresh bread year-round. A notice board near the fountain displays recipes, workshop schedules, and requests for help.
locationBlueprints.shortDescription: Central gathering space with a hearth, fountain, and market stalls.

locationBlueprints.name: Community Kitchen Exterior
locationBlueprints.description:
A wide wooden building with a red-tiled roof and a large chimney that smells perpetually of garlic and thyme. The front porch holds stacked crates of vegetables, hanging braids of dried peppers, and a sign that lists today's shared meals. A small herb garden borders the side wall, neatly divided into labeled plots.

The entrance features double doors with frosted glass panels, letting golden light spill onto the path. Inside, the sounds of chopping, stirring, and laughter can be heard on most days. A chalkboard outside notes who is cooking and when the next communal dinner will be served.
locationBlueprints.shortDescription: Warm kitchen building where residents share meals and cooking lessons.

locationBlueprints.name: Herbal Alchemy Shop Exterior
locationBlueprints.description:
A narrow two-story building with climbing vines and a bell above the door that chimes softly in the breeze. The ground-floor window displays rows of labeled jars containing dried roots, berries, and crystallized powders. A small wooden sign reads "Simple Remedies, Honest Prices."

The upper floor has a balcony with potted night-blooming flowers and a small drying rack for herbs. A stone path leads around the side to a back door that opens onto a small garden of medicinal plants. The air near the shop always carries a faint minty scent.
locationBlueprints.shortDescription: Small alchemy shop selling remedies and herbal supplies.

locationBlueprints.name: General Store Exterior
locationBlueprints.description:
A sturdy timber building with a slanted roof and an awning painted in faded blue stripes. The front porch holds baskets of seasonal produce, spools of thread, and neatly stacked boxes of basic tools. A hand-painted sign lists today's featured items in looping script.

The large front windows display jars of preserves, bolts of cloth, and kitchenware arranged in tidy rows. A bell above the door rings when opened, and the interior smells of wood polish, dried fruit, and new paper. A small notice board near the entrance posts trade requests and caravan schedules.
locationBlueprints.shortDescription: General store selling household goods, tools, and basic supplies.

locationBlueprints.name: Ember Hollow Outskirts
locationBlueprints.description:
The edge of the settlement where paved paths give way to dirt tracks and wild grass. Wooden fences mark private gardens, and a few outbuildings serve as tool sheds and chicken coops. A stone milestone lists distances to nearby towns and crossroads.

Beyond the fences, the land opens into rolling fields and scattered trees. The road splits here: one path leads toward a forested ridge, another toward a river crossing, and a third climbs toward a highland trail. Travelers often rest at the small bench near the milestone before continuing.
locationBlueprints.shortDescription: Edge of town where paths split toward nearby regions.

locationBlueprints.name: Ember Hollow Gardens
locationBlueprints.description:
A shared garden plot behind the village square, divided into neat sections for vegetables, herbs, and flowers. Wooden trellises support climbing beans and morning glories, while stone borders keep the rows straight. A small water pump and enchanted watering can sit near the center path.

The soil is dark and rich, kept fertile by compost and mild growth enchantments. A few scarecrows with painted smiles stand guard against birds. A small shed holds extra tools, seeds, and a chalkboard listing who tends which plot.
locationBlueprints.shortDescription: Shared garden plots for growing food, herbs, and flowers.

locationBlueprints.name: Ember Hollow Workshop Row
locationBlueprints.description:
A short street lined with small workshop buildings where residents craft furniture, repair tools, and weave textiles. Smoke curls from a few chimneys, and the sound of hammers and saws drifts through the air on busy days. Finished items are often displayed on front steps or porch rails.

Each workshop has its own sign and style, from neatly painted facades to rustic plank walls. A communal woodpile and water barrel sit near the center for shared use. A small notice board lists available commissions and skill-sharing sessions.
locationBlueprints.shortDescription: Row of small craft workshops for carpentry, weaving, and repairs.

locationBlueprints.name: Ember Hollow Rest House Exterior
locationBlueprints.description:
A low building with wide windows and a gently sloping roof designed to shed snow and rain. The front porch holds potted plants and a sign listing room rates and available amenities. A small lantern above the door glows faintly even in daylight.

The walls are built from thick timber and stone, keeping the interior warm in winter and cool in summer. A small herb garden and a bench near the entrance provide a quiet spot for travelers to rest. The air carries a faint scent of lavender and clean linen.
locationBlueprints.shortDescription: Small inn offering rooms and meals to travelers and locals.

locationBlueprints.name: Ember Hollow Training Yard
locationBlueprints.description:
An open grassy area bordered by wooden posts and hanging training dummies. A few practice weapons lean against a rack near the edge, and chalk lines mark sparring zones on the ground. A small shelter holds first-aid supplies and water barrels.

The yard is used for self-defense lessons, fitness routines, and occasional friendly tournaments. A notice board lists upcoming classes and instructors. The sound of footsteps and light impacts echoes across the space on active days.
locationBlueprints.shortDescription: Open yard used for self-defense training and physical practice.

locationBlueprints.name: Ember Hollow Riverbank
locationBlueprints.description:
A shallow river runs along the edge of the settlement, its banks lined with smooth stones and tall reeds. A wooden footbridge connects the two sides, and a small fishing platform juts out over the water. The current is gentle but steady, carrying fallen leaves downstream.

Locals use the river for washing, fishing, and cooling off in summer. A few enchanted stones near the bank keep the water clean and free of debris. A narrow path follows the river upstream toward a small grove and downstream toward the outskirts.
locationBlueprints.shortDescription: Quiet riverbank used for fishing, washing, and short walks.

locationBlueprints.name: Ember Hollow Children's Play Area
locationBlueprints.description:
A small fenced yard with a wooden climbing frame, a low swing set, and a sandbox edged with smooth stones. Brightly painted murals of animals and flowers decorate the fence panels. A bench near the gate lets adults watch while they chat or read.

The ground is covered in soft mulch and sand to cushion falls. A small water pump and toy bucket stand near the sandbox for summer play. The area is quiet during work hours but lively in the late afternoon.
locationBlueprints.shortDescription: Small safe play area for children with swings and climbing frame.

locationBlueprints.name: Ember Hollow Tool Shed Exterior
locationBlueprints.description:
A small stone-and-timber building near the gardens with a heavy wooden door and a padlock that clicks softly when opened. The roof is thick with moss, and vines climb one corner of the wall. A sign reads "Shared Tools, Return Clean."

Inside, racks hold hoes, shovels, saws, and watering cans, all labeled and oiled regularly. A small notice board tracks who has borrowed what. The air smells of wood, metal, and dried herbs.
locationBlueprints.shortDescription: Shared tool shed for farming and repair equipment.

locationBlueprints.name: Ember Hollow Watchtower Exterior
locationBlueprints.description:
A tall wooden tower on a small hill overlooking the settlement, built with wide steps and a covered platform at the top. Lanterns hang from the railings, and a small bell can be rung to signal warnings or gatherings. The structure is sturdy, with thick posts and cross-bracing.

The tower is used for keeping watch, spotting weather changes, and guiding travelers at night. A small shelter at the base holds blankets, a first-aid kit, and a logbook for night watch notes. The view from the top shows the whole valley and the roads beyond.
locationBlueprints.shortDescription: Wooden watchtower for monitoring weather, threats, and travelers.

secrets: A hidden cellar beneath the community kitchen stores an old recipe book with enchanted dishes that grant temporary stat boosts.
One of the garden plots contains a patch of moonbloom flowers that only open on clear nights and can be used in rare alchemy recipes.
The watchtower logbook contains coded notes about a nearby abandoned mine that occasionally emits strange sounds.
A loose floorboard in the rest house leads to a small stash of travel maps marked with secret shortcuts.
The riverbank hides a sunken stone marker that glows faintly when touched by someone with strong magical affinity.
One workshop's back wall conceals a narrow passage to a forgotten storage cave filled with old tools and materials.
The children's play area sandbox covers a small buried time capsule left by the original settlers of Ember Hollow.

region_1785944283704_ns9czhd5.name: Community Kitchen Interior
region_1785944283704_ns9czhd5.description: A spacious kitchen with long wooden tables, multiple stoves, and shelves full of spices and preserved goods. Enchanted ovens keep food warm without burning, and a large pantry stores bulk ingredients. The walls are covered in recipe cards, photos, and children's drawings.
region_1785944283704_ns9czhd5.shortDescription: Wide cooking area with stoves, tables, and meal chalkboard.

locationBlueprints.name: Main Cooking Hall
locationBlueprints.description:
The central space opens around a long wooden table scarred by years of chopping and ladling. At the far wall, three heavy stoves feed a row of large iron cauldrons, and a copper kettle whistles when the heat rises too high. Recipe cards and faded photos are pinned to the boards between the shelves, held up by thumbtacks and bits of twine.

A chalkboard near the entrance lists today’s meals and who is on duty. The air smells of garlic, onion, and wood smoke, and the floor is swept clean except for a few damp marks from mopped spills. A small bench along the wall holds stacks of chipped bowls and ladles ready for service.
locationBlueprints.shortDescription: Wide cooking area with stoves, tables, and meal chalkboard.

locationBlueprints.name: Prep and Cutting Area
locationBlueprints.description:
A long stone counter runs along one wall, marked with knife scratches and dried broth stains. Several cutting boards sit in a row, each with its own set of knives and a small bowl for scraps. A low shelf holds salt, oil, and a stack of clean cloths for wiping hands and counters.

A metal sink with a hand pump sits at the far end, draining into a short channel that leads to a covered catch basin. The floor here is kept extra dry, and a small sign warns against slipping near the drain. A hook on the wall holds a heavy wooden mallet for tenderizing meat.
locationBlueprints.shortDescription: Workstation with cutting boards, knives, and a scrubbed sink.

locationBlueprints.name: Pantry and Spice Rack
locationBlueprints.description:
Tall wooden shelves line the walls, stacked with jars of dried beans, grains, and preserved vegetables. A narrow aisle runs between two rows of racks, each labeled in neat handwriting with chalk or ink. Small glass bottles of spices sit on the upper shelves, their corks wrapped in cloth to keep out moisture.

A low table near the door holds measuring cups, scales, and a ledger for tracking ingredient use. The air is dry and faintly sweet from stored herbs and cured meats. A hanging sign reminds everyone to replace anything they take from the shelves.
locationBlueprints.shortDescription: Stocked shelves of grains, jars, and labeled spice bottles.

locationBlueprints.name: Dining Nook
locationBlueprints.description:
A cluster of small tables sits near a set of frosted windows, letting in pale daylight that mixes with the steam from the kitchen. Wooden benches line the walls, and a low shelf holds stacks of clean napkins and mugs. Children’s drawings and recipe cards are taped to the wall between the tables.

A serving counter separates this space from the cooking area, with a small heat lamp keeping bowls of soup and stew warm. The floor is worn smooth from foot traffic, and a trash bin near the door catches leftover scraps and paper wrappers.
locationBlueprints.shortDescription: Small seating area with tables, benches, and a serving counter.

locationBlueprints.name: Enchanted Oven Alcove
locationBlueprints.description:
A recessed corner holds three heavy ovens with glass doors and brass dials, each marked with a simple rune that keeps the heat steady. Baking trays and clay pots sit inside, their contents slow-cooking without burning. A metal rack above the ovens holds bread loaves and roasted vegetables.

A small chalkboard lists which dishes are in each oven and who put them there. The air here is hotter than the rest of the kitchen, and the floor is swept clean to avoid grease fires. A bucket of sand sits near the door in case of spills.
locationBlueprints.shortDescription: Warm corner with rune-marked ovens and slow-cooking trays.

locationBlueprints.name: Back Storage Room
locationBlueprints.description:
A narrow room holds stacked crates, spare pots, and bundles of firewood kept dry against the wall. A metal shelf near the door carries cleaning supplies, extra rags, and a coil of rope for tying crates. The floor is covered in sawdust to soak up spills and keep it from slipping.

A small window high on the wall lets in a thin slice of light, and a wooden bench sits against the opposite wall for resting during heavy shifts. A sign on the door warns about low headroom near the stacked boxes.
locationBlueprints.shortDescription: Cluttered room with crates, tools, and dry firewood.

secrets: A loose floorboard under the prep sink hides a small tin of rare spice blends saved for special dishes.
One oven’s rune can be tuned to preserve food longer, but only if the right herb ash is mixed into the seal.
A folded recipe card behind a spice jar describes a broth that briefly boosts stamina for anyone who drinks it.
The back storage room’s highest shelf conceals a hidden compartment with old ledgers tracking past meal quotas.
A faded children’s drawing on the dining wall hides a tiny note pointing to a forgotten stash of extra bowls.

region_1785944283704_r1qr7k1i.name: Herbal Alchemy Shop Interior
region_1785944283704_r1qr7k1i.description: A cozy shop filled with shelves of bottles, drying racks, and a workbench cluttered with pestles and scales. A small testing area near the back holds glassware and a low-burning spirit lamp. The walls are lined with reference books and hand-drawn botanical sketches.
region_1785944283704_r1qr7k1i.shortDescription: The main sales and sorting area of the alchemy shop.

locationBlueprints.name: Shop Floor
locationBlueprints.description: The entrance opens directly onto a scarred wooden counter that runs the length of the front wall. Behind the counter, Tsubaki stands ready to mix remedies or answer questions. Shelves rise from floor to ceiling, holding rows of glass jars with dried roots, powdered minerals, and crystallized herbs. A small bell above the door chimes when someone enters. The air is dry and smells of mint and earth.
locationBlueprints.shortDescription: The main sales and sorting area of the alchemy shop.

locationBlueprints.name: Stairwell
locationBlueprints.description: A narrow wooden staircase leads up to the second floor, worn smooth by years of use. The walls here are lined with reference books and hand-drawn botanical sketches. A small window lets in dim light, illuminating dust motes dancing in the air. The stairs creak slightly underfoot.
locationBlueprints.shortDescription: Narrow wooden stairs connecting the shop floor to the upper level.

locationBlueprints.name: Upper Lab
locationBlueprints.description: The upper floor is a cluttered workspace filled with glassware, pestles, and low-burning spirit lamps. A large table dominates the center, surrounded by stools and stacks of papers. Tsubaki’s living quarters are tucked in the back, separated by a curtain. The room is warm from the lamps and smells of chemicals and dried herbs.
locationBlueprints.shortDescription: Tsubaki’s private laboratory and living quarters on the second floor.

secrets: A hidden compartment in the Upper Lab contains a rare moonbloom seed packet.
Tsubaki’s reference books include a coded journal about local monster girl ailments.
A loose floorboard in the Shop Floor hides a small stash of copper coins.
